description: Perform an Independent Samples T-Test on the 'ToothGrowth' dataset to compare tooth length ('len') between supplement types ('supp'). In the analysis options, enable 'Effect Size' (Cohen's d) and its 'Confidence Interval' (95%). Save the analysis as '~/Documents/Jamovi/ToothGrowth_EffectSize.omv' and create a text report '~/Documents/Jamovi/effect_size_report.txt' containing the Lower and Upper bounds of the Cohen's d confidence interval.
